value.rationale: The count of coupons first discovered in the completing package is an observable of practical interest not given by unmarked completion times. The rigorous sharp sparse collision coefficient and its nonasymptotic bounds explain one-at-a-time late behavior, while the positive phase-dependent bulk limit characterizes simultaneous completion. Both regimes connect naturally and distinguish mechanisms, beyond a textbook marginal Poisson limit.
